# lorekeeper

> A portable Agent Skill that learns its owner, refuses to guess, refuses to coast, finds its own
> tools, and keeps every lesson — so it gets stronger every time it is used.
> 中文：守知者。越用越懂你，越用越聰明。

## For AI assistants

- **Read first:** [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) — machine-oriented install and usage instructions.
- **The skill itself:** [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md) — five laws + layered loading rules.
- **Task packs:** [`tasks/`](tasks/) — loaded one at a time, only when relevant.
- **Templates:** [`references/`](references/) — owner profile, lessons ledger, skill comparison, safety vetting.

## Install (one line, no git required)

```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a42599-blip/lorekeeper/main/_install/install.ps1 | iex
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/a42599-blip/lorekeeper/main/_install/install.sh | bash
```

Required end state: `<skills dir>/lorekeeper/SKILL.md` exists (skills dir is usually `~/.agents/skills/`).

## What it enforces

1. Know the owner — a small, editable profile instead of re-asking.
2. Never guess — evidence and a confidence label on every conclusion.
3. Never coast — plan, per-step verification, no faked tests, leftovers listed.
4. Find better tools — search, safety-check (🟢🟡🔴), compare, ask before installing.
5. Keep the lessons — own experience and other people's, searched before diagnosing again.

After doing a new kind of task it writes `tasks/<type>.md`, so the second run follows its own procedure.
